claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item variant. types.ts defines only SpellRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, and MasteryRecord. Magic items require a distinct record kind (attunement, rarity, equip-slot) and a mechanics family that can express passive persistent effects, weapon modifiers, and charged/use-count abilities — none of which map cleanly to the three existing families.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial), Legendary (Requires Attunement by a Paladin)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_filter on DamageOnHitOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The extra 2d10 Radiant damage fires only against Fiends and Undead. DamageOnHitOperation has no targetFilter field. A closed enum of creature types (fiend, undead, dragon, …) would be needed as a filter predicate on the damage rider.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 Radiant damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emanation attachment with friendly-creature scope
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The aura is a self-centered emanation (not a point-origin sphere). It applies to the wielder and all 'Friendly' creatures inside it. Existing Attachment has `area` with shape `sphere` and `origin: point_within_range | on_primary_target` — neither models a self-centered aura. The scope filter ('Friendly to you') is also absent from the current attachment vocabulary.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it creates a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. You and all creatures Friendly to you in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: class_level_threshold scaling on area radius
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The emanation radius jumps from 10 ft to 30 ft when the wielder has 17+ Paladin levels. No existing DiceAmount or scaling variant addresses threshold-tiered growth of an attachment's radius based on a named class level. A ThresholdTiers<number> on a radius field would be needed, keyed by a specific class (paladin) and level (17).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the Emanation increases to 30 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_roll as a RollKind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: RollKind = 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw'. The +3 bonus applies to damage rolls, which are neither. Expressing weapon bonus modifiers (attack + damage) requires adding 'damage_roll' to RollKind or introducing a dedicated weapon_modifier surface type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
